# Webflow Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that manages your Webflow sites: list sites, list CMS collections, list items, and create, update, delete, and publish CMS items. All writes — create, update, delete, and especially publishing — need your confirmation first, because publishing changes the live site. Uses a per-site Webflow token (Site Settings > Integrations > API access), kept in Muse's secure vault. Honest note: working with CMS content and publishing requires a Webflow site plan; the API rate-limits to about 60 requests per minute. Draft: written from Webflow's public API v2 docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
